cpm.installations.description: Known C/C++ toolchain root or bin directories detected or added manually.
cpm.installations.markdownDescription: Known C/C++ toolchain root or bin directories detected or added manually.

cpm.activeInstallation.description: Selected C/C++ toolchain root or bin directory. Leave empty to use automatic detection from PATH and common MinGW/MSYS2/Clang locations.

cpm.cCompilerPath.description: C compiler executable used by the generic build pipeline, for example gcc or an absolute MinGW gcc.exe path.

cpm.cppCompilerPath.description: C++ compiler and linker executable used by the generic build pipeline, for example g++ or an absolute MinGW g++.exe path.

cpm.archiverPath.description: Static-library archiver executable used for Static Library targets.

cpm.debuggerPath.description: GDB executable used when launching the VS Code cppdbg debugger.

cpm.autoLoadWorkspace.description: Automatically load a .cws file when the opened VS Code folder contains exactly one C/C++ workspace.

cpm.showPersistentStatusBarActions.description: Show compact C/C++ Project Manager actions in the VS Code status bar. These actions remain available when the C/C++ Workspace view is collapsed.

cpm.autoConfigureCppTools.description: Automatically create or update the managed C/C++ Project Manager entry in .vscode/c_cpp_properties.json when a C/C++ workspace is opened or the selected installation changes. Disabled by default to avoid slowing Microsoft C/C++ IntelliSense; use the Sync IntelliSense command manually.

cpm.autoAddCpmFolderToWorkspace.description: Automatically add the precise C/C++ project root to the standard VS Code Explorer. Disabled by default to avoid unexpected workspace changes and large IntelliSense indexing scopes.

cpm.intelliSenseCompilerPath.description: Optional explicit compiler executable used by Microsoft C/C++ IntelliSense. Leave empty to use the selected gcc/g++/clang toolchain.

cpm.additionalIncludePaths.description: Additional include directories appended to the generated C/C++ IntelliSense configuration.

cpm.projectFormatVersion.description: Internal .cws/.prj format version used when generating new C/C++ Project Manager workspaces. Keep the default unless you need compatibility with a specific legacy parser.

cpm.buildMode.description: Build mode used by the generic C/C++ build pipeline. Debug modes add -g -O0; release modes add -O2.
enumDescriptions: Debug, 64-bit: -g -O0 (and -m64 when architecture flags are enabled)
Release, 64-bit: -O2 (and -m64 when architecture flags are enabled)

cpm.outputDirectory.description: Directory, relative to the project file by default, used to store generic compiler objects and fallback targets.

cpm.cStandard.description: C language standard passed as -std=<value>. auto does not pass a C standard flag.

cpm.cppStandard.description: C++ language standard passed as -std=<value>. auto does not pass a C++ standard flag.

cpm.warningLevel.description: Predefined warning profile used by the generic GCC/MinGW build pipeline. none passes no warning flag; all adds -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wconversion.

cpm.optimizationLevel.description: Optimization profile used by the generic build pipeline. mode-default uses -O0 for Debug and -O2 for Release.
enumDescriptions: -Ofast: aggressive, may break strict standard compliance

cpm.debugInformation.description: Debug-information profile used by the generic build pipeline. mode-default adds -g only for Debug configurations.

cpm.architectureMode.description: Architecture flag mode. auto uses the selected compiler default; from-build-mode maps Debug/Release to -m32 and Debug64/Release64 to -m64.

cpm.useBuildModeArchitectureFlags.description: When enabled, x86 modes add -m32 and x64 modes add -m64. Keep disabled if you select architecture by choosing a specific compiler path.

cpm.compilerFlags.description: Additional flags passed to both C and C++ compilation commands.

cpm.cCompilerFlags.description: Additional flags passed only to C compilation commands.

cpm.cppCompilerFlags.description: Additional flags passed only to C++ compilation commands.

cpm.linkerFlags.description: Additional flags passed to the final link command.

cpm.includePaths.description: Additional include directories. Relative paths are resolved from the project file directory.

cpm.libraryPaths.description: Additional library search directories passed as -L entries. Relative paths are resolved from the project file directory.

cpm.libraries.description: Additional libraries passed to the linker. Values may be names such as m/ws2_32 or complete -l flags.

cpm.useLocalBuildCacheForOneDrive.description: When the project is located under OneDrive and the normal object directory cannot be created, fall back to a local build cache for intermediate object files.

enumDescriptions: Show phase summaries, warnings, errors and final status only.
Show phases, compiled files, timings, structured diagnostics, hints and final status without full compiler commands.
Show normal report plus full commands and successful raw output in the main output channel.
cpm.buildLogDetail.description: Controls how much information the structured CPM build report shows in the main C/C++ Project Manager output channel. Full raw output is always preserved in C/C++ Project Manager - Build Trace.

cpm.runArguments.description: Arguments passed to the active executable when running it.

enumDescriptions: Run the executable in a VS Code integrated terminal. Recommended for printf/std::cout and interactive stdin (scanf/std::cin).
Capture stdout and stderr in the C/C++ Project Manager - Program Output channel. Standard input is not interactive in this mode.
Launch in the background without capturing stdout/stderr, matching the legacy CPM behavior.
cpm.runOutputMode.description: Where CPM displays stdout/stderr when running an executable outside the debugger.

cpm.runtimeDependencyMode.description: Dynamic-runtime deployment policy. copy-dlls copies detected GCC/MinGW/MSYS2 and LLVM/Clang runtime DLLs beside the target; path-only uses the selected toolchain through PATH. The legacy static-link value is still accepted for migration, but new static builds should use the per-project Linkage mode in CPM Build Settings.
enumDescriptions: Copy the toolchain runtime DLLs beside the target
Use the toolchain through PATH at run/debug time

cpm.deployRuntimeDlls.description: Legacy setting for toolchain runtime DLL deployment. Prefer cpm.runtimeDependencyMode.
cpm.deployRuntimeDlls.deprecationMessage: Use cpm.runtimeDependencyMode instead. Legacy auto maps to copy-dlls and never maps to path-only.

cpm.cleanRuntimeDllsOnDeploy.description: Before deploying toolchain runtime DLLs beside the target, remove stale or architecture-mismatched runtime DLLs managed by CPM from the target directory. This prevents x86/x64 runtime DLL mix-ups when switching build modes or toolchains.

enumDescriptions: Hybrid: CPM adds active-project symbols, lightweight standard-library assistance and immediate Signature Help. Microsoft C/C++ or another native provider may also contribute results.
Native: CPM contributes no completion items or Signature Help; Microsoft C/C++ (or another installed provider) remains untouched.
Native + CPM Signature Help: completion stays native while CPM provides immediate prototypes and active-parameter hints after ( and ,.
Standard Library Assist: project completion stays native; CPM adds missing-header standard-library completion plus immediate Signature Help.
Custom: use the advanced CPM completion/signature switches below.
cpm.autocompleteProfile.description: Select how CPM participates in C/C++ autocompletion. CPM never disables or rewrites another extension provider when switching profiles.

cpm.enableSupplementalCompletionProvider.description: Custom profile only: master switch for the CPM supplemental C/C++ completion provider. It is scoped to files belonging to the active CPM workspace.

cpm.enableSupplementalProjectCompletion.description: Custom profile only: include functions discovered in the active CPM project sources and headers in CPM completion.

cpm.enableStandardLibraryCompletionProvi.description: Custom profile only: include lightweight completion items for common C/C++ standard-library symbols when the matching header is not already included.

cpm.enableSupplementalSignatureHelp.description: Custom profile only: show immediate parameter/signature help for project and standard-library functions after typing ( or , in CPM workspace files.

cpm.standardLibraryCompletionAutoInclude.description: When a standard-library completion item is accepted, insert the required #include if it is missing from the current file.

cpm.sdlEnabled.description: SDL build integration mode. off disables SDL flags; auto injects SDL only for projects that include or call SDL; on always injects SDL for active builds.
enumDescriptions: Inject SDL only for projects that include or call SDL

cpm.sdlVersion.description: SDL major version used by the generic build pipeline. auto infers SDL2 or SDL3 from selected packages and source includes.
enumDescriptions: Infer SDL2 or SDL3 from packages and includes

cpm.sdlInstallations.description: Known SDL SDK root directories detected or added manually.

cpm.sdlRootPath.description: Selected SDL2/SDL3 SDK directory. This can be the SDK root, an architecture folder such as i686-w64-mingw32/x86_64-w64-mingw32, or a nested bin/lib/include/include\SDL2 folder. Leave empty to let CPM auto-scan common SDK roots when a project uses SDL.

cpm.sdlPackages.description: SDL packages linked by the generic build pipeline. SDL2 or SDL3 core is selected from cpm.sdlVersion; extension packages are added when selected and present in the SDK.

cpm.sdlRuntimeMode.description: How SDL runtime dependencies are handled. copy-dlls copies SDL2/SDL3 DLLs beside the executable; path-only prepends SDL bin to PATH at run/debug; static-link uses static SDL libraries when available.
enumDescriptions: Copy SDL DLLs beside the executable
Prepend the SDL bin directory to PATH at run/debug time
Link static SDL libraries when available

cpm.sdlSubsystem.description: Windows subsystem used for SDL executable linking. windows hides the console with -mwindows; console keeps terminal output visible with -mconsole.
enumDescriptions: -mconsole: keep the console for terminal output

cpm.sdlCopyAllRuntimeDlls.description: When SDL runtime mode is copy-dlls, copy every DLL from the SDL bin directory. This helps SDL_image, SDL_ttf and similar packages that may depend on companion DLLs.
